relationships.notes: Polaris must demonstrate first fusion electricity generation before Orion commercial plant construction proceeds. Helion's stated requirement.
SPARC Q>1 net energy demonstration (2027) is the direct gate condition for ARC commercial plant engineering design and construction start.
Infinity One prototype (commissioning 2029, Bull Run Complex) must succeed before Infinity Two (350 MWe commercial plant, same site) construction proceeds.
Alpha (Garching) must achieve net energy gain by 2031 before Stellaris (Gundremmingen) commercial plant engineering and construction proceeds.
Helix HARUKA integrated demonstration (NIFS campus, Toki) must achieve full system integration before KANATA pilot plant is designed and sited.
ST80-HTS (Culham) validates HTS magnet performance and informs ST-E1 pilot plant design.
LM26 Lawson Program milestones through mid-2028 gate General Fusion FOAK commercial plant final design.
Colorado demonstration facility proof-of-technology (2027) gates Marvel Fusion 100 MWe pilot power plant.
BEST D-T burning plasma and electricity generation demonstration (~2027–2030) informs CFETR engineering design and validates China's commercial fusion path.
Pacific Fusion Demonstration System net facility gain (QF>1, 2030) at Albuquerque campus gates the commercial fusion plant by mid-2030s.
EU DEMO engineering design and construction are explicitly contingent on ITER D-T operational results (post-2035).
JA-DEMO engineering design is contingent on ITER operational results per official Japanese programme roadmap.
K-DEMO design informed by ITER, though Korea's 2025 acceleration plan also pursues a parallel compact pilot device (CPD) to reduce ITER dependence.
Phoenix laser system (2026) gates Anvil 200 kJ IFE beamline demonstrator (2028).
Anvil (2028) gates Vulcan engineering breakeven laser (2031).
Vulcan wall-plug engineering breakeven (2031) is the gate condition for Xcimer Athena 400 MWe commercial plant.
HH70 operational results gate HH170 design and construction. HH170 targets Q>1 as precursor to commercial demonstration reactor.
NTST engineering verification (2028) gates StellarRing commercial demonstration reactor (2033 target).
Century demo system (operational Oct 2024, Everett WA) must achieve DOE Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program milestones before Zap commercial plant can proceed.

Thunderwall unit-cell laser prototype and target factory at Livermore must demonstrate performance and manufacturing scale before Inertia's gigawatt commercial plant can proceed (~2030 groundbreaking target).

audit_notes.note: Pacific Fusion was entirely absent from the prior dataset despite being one of the most significant US fusion developments of 2025: $900M+ raised (second-largest Series A in fusion history), named site at Albuquerque (Mesa del Sol) with formal government approvals and $776.6M in industrial revenue bonds, construction starting 2026, and a credible mid-2030s commercial plant roadmap. Added as both a primary_project (commercial plant roadmap) and precursor_facility (Demonstration System).

Energy Singularity (Shanghai, China) was absent. China's first private fusion company achieved a world record for a commercially built device (1,337-second sustained plasma, April 2026) on its HH70 HTS tokamak, and is developing HH170 for Q>1. Represents the leading Chinese private tokamak effort and merits inclusion as a precursor facility.

StellarRing Fusion was absent. Raised 1B yuan (~$140M) in Jan 2026 — China's largest single private fusion round. NTST device construction targeting Shanghai 2026. Commercial demo reactor 2033. Added to missing_candidates as watchlist candidate.

Focused Energy (LightHouse pilot plant) was absent. $175M+ raised, $65M Bay Area laser facility, named pilot plant (LightHouse), LLE research partnership, end-of-2030s commercial target. Added to missing_candidates as watchlist candidate.

Renaissance Fusion was absent despite CATF European Industrial Strategy report (Sept 2025) citing them with a demonstrator in late 2026 and 1 GW plant target in early 2030s. €32M raised, Grenoble-based, unique HTS+liquid metal stellarator. Added to missing_candidates as watchlist candidate.

Novatron Fusion Group (Nordics) was absent. Only private Nordic fusion company. N1 first plasma 2025, N3 pilot plant siting study completed (Finland preferred), Studsvik partnership March 2026. Added to missing_candidates as watchlist candidate (low confidence due to very early stage).

China Fusion Energy Co. (CFEC) — CNNC state subsidiary launched July 2025 with $2.1B registered capital — was only partially captured via BEST and CFETR records. Added to missing_candidates as program_roadmap candidate to represent the Chinese state commercialization umbrella distinctly.

important_unique adds 12 projects beyond commercial_race: (1) SPARC — world's largest private fusion device under active construction, direct gate to ARC; critical that informed users see it. (2) Polaris — direct gate to Orion (must demonstrate electricity first); only 7th-gen MIF prototype in existence. (3) BEST — $2.1B state-backed burning plasma device under construction at Hefei; China's most concrete near-term fusion step; targets world's first fusion electricity ~2030. (4) Inertia Thunderwall — $450M Series A, NIF-ignition co-founders, landmark LLNL partnership (~200 patents), only NIF-physics-grounded private laser system; strategically unique. (5) Infinity One — first US fusion license application, TVA campus, direct gate to Infinity Two; nationally significant regulatory milestone. (6) ST80-HTS — 11.8T HTS magnet world milestone (Nov 2025), STEP magnet partner; field-shaping hardware. (7) Zap Century — operational at Everett WA, $327M, Z-pinch is technologically unique (no external magnets or lasers), TransAlta coal-to-fusion siting study. (8) Proxima Alpha — Garching site agreed, Q>1 by 2031 target, direct gate to Stellaris; significant European stellarator milestone. (9) Marvel Fusion Colorado — under construction at CSU Fort Collins, $125M+, Siemens Energy FPP design partner; only US-sited laser fusion facility under construction beside Inertia. (10) Energy Singularity HH70 — world record 1,337s sustained plasma (April 2026), China's first private HTS tokamak; geographically and technologically unique representation of Chinese private sector. (11) FAST Japan — Japan's first private-sector fusion CDR, backed by J-Power/Mitsui/Mitsubishi/SMBC industrial consortium; nationally strategic Japan private fusion anchor. (12) ITER — $22B 35-nation experiment under construction in France; global science anchor; informed users expect to see it on any serious fusion globe.
